about: The watch payload, version 4 (README.md), one list per profile: 'cases' (Sukrara Aura), 'app' (Sukrara, the watch app) and 'field' (Sukrara data field). Each case is a phone state ('phone', times in seconds relative to 'now'; the app's 'metrics' = the report numbers per window, as GlucoseMetrics gives them, 'slots' / 'lastElse' / 'ringRange' / 'lastPlace' = the person's metric settings, 'alerts' = the kinds Sukrara's alert runtime rings, 'open' = whether this phone takes entries now, 'addQuiet' = the minutes its Add treatment's quiet line says (rapid: highs, carbs: lows; absent = off), 'kinds' = what THE kinds' order is decided from, in contracts/treatments/kind-order.json's shape) → the exact payload the phone sends ('payload', absolute epoch seconds; the app's push adds 'key', README) → for the face, what it makes of it at a watch time ('watch': 'at' = the watch clock relative to 'now', 'received' = the watch clock when the message arrived, default 'now'; 'expect' = the face's inputs, README 'On the watch'). Run by AuraPayloadFixtureTest (Android: phone → payload for every profile, and the payload through MonkeyC and back) and the face's link test (Garmin: 'cases' → watch; the app's and the data field's watch side comes with their builds). 'bytes' is a payload as Garmin's own serializer (ciq-companion-app-sdk 2.4.0) wrote it, kept from version 1 (the serialization doesn't change with the payload's version): every reader must decode it to 'bytes.payload'.

cases.name: in range and rising, three hours of history, insulin 80 min ago, 5 days of sensor left

watch.name: the phone out of reach: the dose 3 h 59 min old still shows (rapid insulin stays 4 h, as on the card)
the phone out of reach: at 4 h the field goes by itself
the watch clock 2 min behind the phone: the phone's clock wins, so the age is never too young
the watch clock 5 min ahead: the watch's own (older) age stands

cases.name: LO: no number and no trend
HI: a rate the sensor sent is dropped (LO / HI have no trend)
low and falling, nothing logged: eat carbs
high, insulin 15 min ago: quiet for 45 more minutes, the countdown runs on the watch

watch.name: the quiet ran out with no new message: no pill (the phone's next message says what follows)

cases.name: Mute all until turned off, in range
low muted from the notification, 10 min left, flat
a meal: insulin and carbs logged together 35 min ago

watch.name: the phone out of reach: the insulin's quiet ends, so the carbs no longer ride along (the card's slot)
the phone out of reach: the insulin's 4 h are up

cases.name: long-acting 5 min ago and rapid insulin exactly 4 h ago: no treatment (the card's slot never shows long-acting; rapid stays 4 h)
rapid insulin 3 h 59 min ago: one more minute (its 4 h on the card)

watch.name: 4 h after the dose, no new message: gone
the watch clock 2 min behind the phone: the 4 h end on the phone's clock

cases.name: carbs stay 3 min per gram, between 30 min and 3 h: 5 g 10 min ago, then 80 g from 2 h ago

watch.name: the snack's quiet ends: nothing changes
the phone out of reach: 5 g keep the floor of 30 min, then the 80 g show (3 h at most)

cases.name: warming up, 18 min in: no reading yet

watch.name: 15 min past the warm-up's end without a reading: no longer warming (no readings)

cases.name: the warm-up is over, no reading yet: almost ready
sensor ending: its last 8 h (the countdown setting), 5 h left

watch.name: the end passes while the phone is away

cases.name: nothing paired (not monitoring): no value, nothing else from Sukrara
mmol/L and the person's own limits
an old reading and gaps in the history: each slot is the reading nearest its 5-min mark (within 150 s), else empty

app.name: a full day: 24 h of history, a meal 35 min ago (its rapid read from the pen: long-acting first in the log list), the week's entries for the usual amounts, today's and the week's time in range, GMI as the third metric
very low and falling fast: both ring, eat carbs (carbs first in the log list), nothing logged yet (no last amounts), the very good range on the ring, a 14-day average without enough data
a follower the wearer doesn't let add entries, no data for 25 min: no data rings, no logging, the last-treatment place off (no last, though a rapid insulin runs)
nothing paired (not monitoring): no value, no entries, no metrics, no logging

field.name: in range and rising: the last 3 hours, nothing rings
very high and rising fast, insulin 15 min ago: both ring, quiet for 45 more minutes

older.about: Messages can arrive out of order (a burst of queued ones when the face becomes active again): the watch keeps the newest by 'sent' and drops an older one; a stored payload sent more than 5 min ahead of the watch's clock (the phone's clock was wrong, then fixed) gives way to any new one.

versions.about: A payload whose 'v' isn't 4 or whose 'p' isn't the app's own profile is ignored (the stored one stays and ages); one that isn't a dictionary or lacks 'v' / 'p' / 'sent' too. The list is the face's ('aura'); each app reads it with its own profile.

bytes.by: Garmin's Serializer.serialize, ciq-companion-app-sdk 2.4.0 (maps come out in hash order, strings depth first: a reader follows the offsets, not an order)
